text: COVID-19 vaccines have been proven to cause infertility.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.questionWording: The COVID-19 vaccines have been proven to cause infertility
room.note: 3% definitely true, 24% probably true; the false share is the published remainder. KFF offered definitely/probably true and probably/definitely false; the small remainder gave no answer.

truthSource.label: CDC, COVID-19 vaccines and fertility
truthSource.oneLine: CDC and prospective cohort studies find no association between COVID-19 vaccination and reduced fertility in either partner.
